desc: If you are looking for a true vermin control or long-distance tool, look no further. When Tikka was talking about SUPER varmint, they were meaning it. Tikka T3x Super Varmint offers wide range of adjustable features. The heavy varmint barrel has Tungsten Cerakote coating, stock is upgraded to Roughtech material and two-stage trigger is default for this rifle. T3x has a new modular synthetic stock that has interchangeable pistol grips, making it possible to modify the angle of the grip. This allows for multiple shooting positions.
